detailed_description: 2D-animated. A modern flat-colour anime illustration with bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours and one simple step of soft lavender shading. [Shot 1] Night: the rainy window at the left is dark navy blue, warm amber lamplight from off the left edge, the off-white wall at the right in soft shadow. Seen at seated eye level across the desk, <Subject 1> sits behind the desk in the middle of the frame, waist-up, her shoulders slumped forward. The small white laptop of <Subject 2> stands open on the desktop in front of her, its back to the camera, a cool white glow from its screen lighting her face from below. The thick manga stack of <Subject 3> lies flat on the desktop at the right. Her elbow on the frame's left rests on the desk, her cheek sunk into that palm, squashing it a little; her other arm lies limp on the desk. Her eyelids are heavy, her eyes looking at the screen, her eyebrows tipped up in the middle, her lips slightly parted in a long, slow exhale, her cheeks soft.
